_comment: SPONSORS PAGE COPY (English). REAL CONTENT (2026), partially: the board-approved resolution for 'Taqathon 2' names exactly two confirmed 2026 partners — University of Jeddah as the scientific/academic partner, and Mishkat Interactive Center (مركز مشكاة التفاعلي) for judging support. Beyond those two, no specific sponsor names or tiers (Platinum/Gold/Silver) are confirmed for 2026 — 2025's sponsor list is NOT reused here since none of those are confirmed to be returning. See PROGRESS.md's 'still missing' list. 'supervisors'/'supporters' were moved here from contact.en.json (2026-08-18, user request). REVISED (2026-08-18, user request — 'this whole sentence is not good' + board-language flagged again): tier renamed 'Confirmed Partners' -> 'Partners' (the 'confirmed' qualifier read as hedging/internal status-tracking, not something a visitor needs), intro rewritten with no board/approval framing and no 'still being finalized' internal-status note. University of Jeddah gets its real logo file (already used elsewhere on this page for the Supporting Entities panel) via a new 'logoSrc' field. Mishkat Interactive Center has NO logo file anywhere in assets/ — not invented, 'logoSrc' is simply omitted for that entry and sponsors.njk falls back to name-only for any sponsor without one.
